info.description: Simulated freshdesk API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the ticket.

subject.description: Title or subject line of the support ticket.

description.description: Full body of the ticket, formatted as HTML.

status.description: Numeric status code: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed, 6=Waiting on Customer, 7=Waiting on Third Party.

type.description: Classification of the ticket (e.g., Question, Incident, Problem, Feature Request).

requester_id.description: Identifier of the contact who submitted the ticket.

responder_id.description: Identifier of the agent assigned to handle the ticket.

group_id.description: Identifier of the team group assigned to the ticket.

source.description: Inbound channel for the ticket: 1=Email, 2=Portal, 3=Phone, 4=Forum, 5=Twitter, 6=Facebook, 7=Chat, 8=Mobihelp, 9=Feedback Widget, 10=Outbound Email.

tags.description: Labels or tags attached to the ticket.

created_at.description: Date and time when the ticket was originally created.

updated_at.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the ticket.

private.description: When true, the note is internal and not visible to the requester.

created_at.description: Date and time when the note was created.

mobile.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the contact.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company this contact belongs to.

job_title.description: Professional title or role of the contact.

description.description: Additional notes or context about the contact.

tags.description: Labels or tags associated with the contact.

name.description: Legal or display name of the company.

description.description: Brief overview or notes about the company.

domains.description: Web domains linked to this company.

note.description: Free-form notes attached to the company record.
